observed.stderr:
Usage: oci api-gateway gateway [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  A gateway is a virtual network appliance in a regional subnet. A gateway
  routes inbound traffic to back-end services including public, private, and
  partner HTTP APIs, as well as Oracle Functions. Avoid entering confidential
  information. For more information, see [API Gateway Concepts].

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  For detailed help on any of these individual commands, enter
                  <command> --help.

Commands:
  add-lock            Adds a lock to a Gateway resource.
  change-compartment  Changes the gateway compartment.
  create              Creates a new gateway.
  delete              Deletes the gateway with the given identifier.
  get                 Gets a gateway by identifier.
  list                Returns a list of gateways.
  remove-lock         Removes a lock from a Gateway resource.
  update              Updates the gateway with the given identifier.
